title: Cafe Culture
content: Jeanette and I have been mooching Wi-Fi from coffee shops like everyone else does.She did this sketch of a cafe patron using a Micron brush pen.I guess we’re part of an alarming trend. In one Starbucks, we noticed 14 patrons. Eleven of them were busy with laptops, two were interested in hand-held devices, and one was a kid playing quietly with an empty coffee cup.Nobody spoke, except to say, “Do you mind if I plug this in?”
